summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging and poor drainage in Hastinapur town, Ganga erosion of farmland, delayed sugarcane payment interest at Mawana, and broken civic amenities, while voters credit the mill's cane payments and ongoing road construction.

positives.english: Mawana sugar mill has paid over Rs 311 crore for cane bought so far
positives.hindi: मवाना चीनी मिल ने 311 करोड़ से ज्यादा का गन्ना भुगतान किया
positives.basis: Mill paid Rs 311.34 crore total cane price for cane bought through 7 January 2026 (2025-26 season); 88.91 lakh quintal crushed through 16 January

positives.english: After farmers protested the waterlogging, drainage was done and road repair started
positives.hindi: किसानों की मांग पर खेतों का पानी निकाला गया, फिर सड़क की मरम्मत शुरू
positives.basis: After farmers cut part of the Hastinapur-Chandpur link road over waterlogging, drainage work was carried out by agreement with administration and PWD began repairs (18 July 2026). AC membership of this road segment unconfirmed

positives.english: Road construction has started from State Bank crossing to Bharat Mata Park
positives.hindi: स्टेट बैंक चौराहे से भारत माता पार्क तक सड़क बननी शुरू हुई
positives.basis: Construction began after bhoomi pujan by Nagar Panchayat chairperson Sudha Khatik; completion not reported (26 November 2025)

positives.english: Most of the town's main roads have already been made CC roads
positives.hindi: कस्बे की ज्यादातर मुख्य सड़कें सीसी हो गई हैं
positives.basis: Nagar Panchayat chairperson Sudha Khatik said most main roads have already been converted to CC roads (3 May 2026); this is the chairperson's claim, not independently verified

positives.english: Water coolers have been installed at about 44 places in the town
positives.hindi: शहर में करीब 44 जगह ठंडे पानी के वाटर कूलर लगे हैं
positives.basis: Nagar Panchayat has installed water coolers at about 44 locations; more than half a dozen are out of order (31 May 2026)

negatives.english: Ganga erosion has swallowed fields, and the administration has not made solid arrangements
negatives.hindi: गंगा कटान में खेत बह गए, प्रशासन ने ठोस इंतजाम नहीं किए
negatives.basis: About 10,000 farmers affected, about 5,000 hectares of crops destroyed and over 2,000 hectares of land swallowed by the Ganga; named villages Bastota Narang, Makhdumpur, Kishorpur, Jalalpur Jora (AC membership of these villages unconfirmed) (8 Sept 2025)

negatives.english: Despite about Rs 16 crore of works, roads get waterlogged whenever it rains
negatives.hindi: करीब 16 करोड़ खर्च हुए, फिर भी बारिश में सड़कों पर पानी भरता है
negatives.basis: Article says about Rs 16 crore of development works were carried out, but adequate rainwater drainage arrangements were not made and water collects on many major routes when it rains (28 July 2026); it is Hastinapur town, district-level tourism works

negatives.english: Farmers demand a year-wise statement of interest on delayed sugarcane payments
negatives.hindi: गन्ना भुगतान में देरी का ब्याज कितना बना, उसका हिसाब दो
negatives.basis: Farmers at Mawana Sahkari Ganna Vikas Samiti sat in demanding a year-wise interest statement on cane payments delayed more than 14 days (1996-97 to 2025-26), citing a High Court order; deputy promised a written reply on 7 October (5 Oct 2026)

negatives.english: Repair of dilapidated ward roads is still waiting
negatives.hindi: वार्डों की जर्जर सड़कों की मरम्मत अभी इंतजार में है
negatives.basis: Nagar Panchayat prioritises repair of dilapidated ward roads; DPR for about 25 roads sent to the state government, final approval awaited (3 May 2026)

negatives.english: Coolers are out of order in the scorching heat and people are thirsty
negatives.hindi: भीषण गर्मी में कूलर खराब पड़े हैं, जनता प्यासी है
negatives.basis: More than half a dozen Nagar Panchayat coolers out of order, most not cleaned in two years; resident quote 'यहां जनता प्यासी है' (31 May 2026)

notes: Identity: Wikipedia constituency page confirms no. 45 Hastinapur, SC, district Meerut, Bijnor Lok Sabha; the Wikipedia list row leaves the district cell blank, so the constituency page is the identity source. Extent per that page includes Mawana tehsil units (Mawana MB, Mawana KC villages), Hastinapur NP and Parikshatgarh NP. Ganga erosion villages named in the 2025 article are not checked against the extent, so their membership is unconfirmed and that item is not counted in ac_specific_negatives. Sugarcane mill (Mawana MB) and the Hastinapur NP items are counted as confirmed. Positive 2 (Hastinapur-Chandpur link road) has unconfirmed AC membership of the segment. Not used: Rs 3150 crore iconic site/National Museum approval (Amar Ujala, 8 Feb 2026) because it is an approval announcement with no start date; Patrika Jambudweep statues article is dated 2018, outside the 2024-2026 window; Mawana-Bijnor road blockade of Sept 2026 was over a murder, not civic infrastructure. No 2026 Hastinapur-specific reports on electricity supply, hospital/CHC or drinking-water supply were found; these are field-check priorities. Positive 4 is the chairperson's own claim and should be checked on the ground. Several Hastinapur items come from short video-reports, read via the full page text.
